description: This Go source file defines functions and constants for handling strategic merge patch directives in Kubernetes YAML configurations, including determining and applying patch strategies like replace, delete, and merge.

methods.name: determineSmpDirective
methods.description: Determines the strategic merge patch directive for a given YAML patch node, returning the directive type or an error.

methods.name: determineSequenceNodePatchStrategy
methods.description: Determines the patch strategy for a sequence node based on the $patch directive.

methods.name: determineMappingNodePatchStrategy
methods.description: Determines the patch strategy for a mapping node based on the $patch directive.

methods.name: elideMappingPatchDirective
methods.description: Removes the $patch directive from a mapping node.

methods.name: elideSequencePatchDirective
methods.description: Removes the $patch directive from a sequence node.
